full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic oil painting shows a quiet rocky inlet opening toward a calm sea beneath a broad, luminous, cloud-filled sky. Soft cream and pale blue-gray clouds occupy the upper half, their layered edges warmed by low sunlight near the horizon. The brightest opening sits just left of center, and a narrow silver reflection runs from it across the distant water toward the shore. On the right side, pale granite outcrops rise from the coast, their broken faces catching warm beige and ivory light. Deep umber fissures separate the angular blocks, and dark shrubs gather near the upper right edge. Smaller rocks continue toward the center, stepping down into the inlet and partly screening the far shore. At the left edge, another low, dark rock bank frames the water without closing the view. Across the middle, the sea shifts from muted gray-green to reflective silver where light falls. Gentle ripples and thin white foam curl around submerged stones in the lower center. In the foreground, wet rocks and dark brown seaweed interrupt the shallow water, their irregular surfaces painted with short precise strokes and small glints. The right foreground holds broad weathered stone slabs, whose rounded planes lead diagonally back toward the sunlit cliff. Soft low light spreads through the clouds and strikes the rock faces from the left; crevices and water beneath the stones remain shaded. Fine tonal modulation makes the sky airy, the sea fluid, and the shore solid. The overall composition balances a large calm sky against a detailed weighty foreground, joining muted coastal colors with a restrained band of warm light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形自然主义油画呈现安静的岩石海湾，海湾在宽阔、明亮而多云的天空下通向平静海面。柔和的奶油色和浅蓝灰云层占据上半幅，层叠云缘受到地平线附近低角度阳光的暖化。最明亮的云隙位于中央稍左，一道狭窄银色反光从那里越过远处海面，延向岸边。右侧，浅色花岗岩露头从海岸升起，破碎的岩面接住温暖的米黄和象牙白光。深棕裂隙分开棱角分明的石块，深色灌木聚集在右上缘附近。较小岩石向中央延续，逐级降入海湾，也遮住部分远岸。左边缘另一道低矮深色岩岸围住水面，却没有封闭远景。中部海水从低调的灰绿转向光照下的银色反光。细缓波纹和白色泡沫细线绕过下方中央的水下石块。前景里，湿石与深棕海藻打断浅水，不规则表面由短而精确的笔触和细小闪光刻画。右前景有宽阔的风化石板，圆缓的石面沿斜线引视线回到受光的岩壁。柔和的低角度光穿过云层，从左侧照亮岩面；裂缝和石下海水仍留在阴影里。细腻的色调变化让天空显得通透、海水显得流动、海岸显得坚实。整体构图以大面积平静天空和细节丰富、分量厚重的前景互相平衡，把克制的海岸色调与一带暖光连在一起。
style_prompt_en: The work has a naturalistic oil-painted finish built from patiently modulated tones and fine visible brushwork. Broad atmospheric passages are softer and thinner, while near forms gain weight through small broken strokes, dark recesses, and irregular rough edges. Muted blue-gray, gray-green, warm ivory, and earthy umber remain closely related, with narrow glints of warm light drawing the eye through the cooler field. Diffused low-angle illumination opens the middle distance and picks out raised planes; recessed areas retain deep shadow. Space unfolds from tactile foreground marks through calmer middle tones into pale atmospheric distance. The rhythm moves between quiet horizontal expanses and clustered diagonal forms, giving the image a measured contemplative luminosity.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有自然主义油画的完成面，以耐心调和的色调和细密可见的笔触构成。大片大气层次更柔软轻薄，近处形体则借由短碎笔触、深色凹处与不规则粗边获得重量。低调的蓝灰、灰绿、暖象牙白和土棕彼此协调，窄小的暖色闪光牵引视线穿过较冷的色域。漫射的低角度光打开中距离空间并点亮凸起平面，凹处保持深沉阴影。空间从触感鲜明的前景笔迹，经过较平静的中间色调，展开至苍白朦胧的远处。节奏在安静的水平伸展与成簇的斜向形体之间流动，呈现审慎、沉思的明亮感。
theme_en: A rocky coastal inlet beneath a luminous clouded sky
theme_zh: 明亮云天下的岩石海湾
name: William Trost Richards
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
